body.note: Back up your data before you upgrade.
Restore takes up to an hour.
Restoring replaces all data written after the backup.
body.p: Each key may send 600 requests per minute to the API.
A key may send a burst of 100 requests in one second.
body.note: The plate stays hot during and after operation. Do not touch it.
Keep paper and cloth away from the plate. They can catch fire.
